messages.subject: Project Umbra - Licence Agreement v1 for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry, Sofia,

First full draft of the Patent and Software Licence Agreement attached (v1). Drafted on our preferred terms - exclusive licence, 9% royalty / £1.5m upfront placeholder, liability cap at the greater of £2m / 100% of fees with a £4m IP indemnity cap, five-year term, NCC escrow. Once comfortable we'll send to Pemberton Rowe.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
